title: 建築環境学Ⅱ
subtitle: Architectural Environment II
teachers:
SHIMOKAWA Yuichi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: "Basic ability to plan, design, build and operate safe, beautiful and comfortable architecture and urban space" is the educational goal of the department. In this lecture, you will learn the basics from the physical, physiological and psychological aspects, especially regarding sound and visual environment.
advice:
1. Acoustic environment
1.1 Basics of sound environment planning --- objective and concept of sound environment control, physical quantity of sound, perception of sound
1.2 Sound propagation --- Sound field, sound absorption and sound insulation, air sound control method, noise evaluation
1.3 Sound plan-room acoustics, optimal reverberation time, acoustic disturbance
2. Visual environment
2.1 Basics of Lighting Environment Plan --- Lighting Purpose and Concept, Light Perception, Light Physical Quantity, Comfort, Light Source Characteristics
2.2 Lighting plan --- Lighting equipment and lighting system, artificial lighting and daylighting
2.3 Lighting calculation --- Estimation and design of illuminance by point-by-point method and luminous flux method

● Self-confirmation sheet: Submit a summary of the lesson content from notes and textbooks (review). The status of submission is included in the evaluation as self-study status. You will need to make a copy if necessary.
● Scientific calculator: A calculator is required for various exercises and quizzes.
books: Illustrated Text Building Environmental Engineering 2nd Edition (SHOKOKUSYA)
requiredKnowledge: It is a continuous and evolving content of "Architectural environment I". Review of the previous knowledge.

              "Basic ability to plan, design, build and operate safe, beautiful and comfortable architecture and urban space" is the educational goal of the department. In this lecture, you will learn the basics from the physical, physiological and psychological aspects, especially regarding sound and visual environment.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              1. Acoustic environment
1.1 Basics of sound environment planning --- objective and concept of sound environment control, physical quantity of sound, perception of sound
1.2 Sound propagation --- Sound field, sound absorption and sound insulation, air sound control method, noise evaluation
1.3 Sound plan-room acoustics, optimal reverberation time, acoustic disturbance
2. Visual environment
2.1 Basics of Lighting Environment Plan --- Lighting Purpose and Concept, Light Perception, Light Physical Quantity, Comfort, Light Source Characteristics
2.2 Lighting plan --- Lighting equipment and lighting system, artificial lighting and daylighting
2.3 Lighting calculation --- Estimation and design of illuminance by point-by-point method and luminous flux method

● Self-confirmation sheet: Submit a summary of the lesson content from notes and textbooks (review). The status of submission is included in the evaluation as self-study status. You will need to make a copy if necessary.
● Scientific calculator: A calculator is required for various exercises and quizzes.
